say:3:1620567002:1.text: Liselle... Yeah, I've heard a few of the others mention that name.
say:3:1620567002:1.source_cn: 莉莎……我确实听过其他动物提起过这个名字。
say:3:1620567002:1.male: Liselle... Yeah, I've heard a few of the others mention that name.

say:4:1620567003:1.text: If I remember right, she's locked up deep inside the cave, in the last cell.
say:4:1620567003:1.source_cn: 我没记错的话，她应该被关在山洞最深处的牢笼里。

say:6:1620567004:1.text: Got it. We'll all gather at the entrance and wait. Once you get Liselle out, we move together.
say:6:1620567004:1.source_cn: 在洞口集结，等你救出莉莎后一起行动？好！我明白了。

say:7:1620567005:1.text: Just be careful. The deeper you go, the more traps the poachers have set. It won't be easy.
say:7:1620567005:1.source_cn: 不过越往深处走，偷猎者布置的陷阱会越多……请务必小心应对。
